summary: Actual independent challenge GOLDBACH-CHEN-024: incomplete for the original prime margin. The signed beyond-half congruence estimate (21) is supported relative to Lichtman Proposition 3.1 after checking the true small-prime alpha sequence, arbitrary large Mobius beta sequence, uniform endpoints, exact two-variable partial summation, residue N, main numerator and genuine triple-factorability assumption. Actual prime-weight, wheel and omitted-sector transport remain unproved. No authority to complete the full goal is exercised.
